en.headline: Police seize record 31 million dollars of etomidate powder
en.dek: Officers found about 25 kilograms of suspected etomidate in a Lai Chi Kok unit disguised as a logistics office and arrested two men.
body: Police said on Wednesday they had made the force's largest seizure of etomidate, taking about 25 kilograms of suspected powder with an estimated street value of more than 31 million Hong Kong dollars.

The Narcotics Bureau raided an industrial unit in Lai Chi Kok on Tuesday and uncovered a storage facility disguised as a logistics company office, the force said. Officers seized the powder and a large quantity of packaging materials. Two men were arrested at the scene. Police said one was a 47-year-old non-ethnic-Chinese shareholder of the logistics firm and the other a 48-year-old local employee.

Investigators said the powder could be used to produce more than 120,000 etomidate e-cigarette pods. They also found new express-delivery packaging, which police said the syndicate used to disguise the drugs as ordinary goods.

Senior inspector Chu Chun-yip said Halloween was approaching and police could not rule out that some people had already begun stockpiling the drug for distribution to entertainment venues. The two men were being detained and were expected to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday on a provisional charge of trafficking in a dangerous drug.

zh.headline: 警搗荔枝角工廈毒品倉 檢獲歷來最多依托咪酯
zh.dek: 毒品調查科在荔枝角一個偽裝成物流公司辦公室的單位，檢獲約25公斤懷疑依托咪酯粉末，市值逾3100萬元，兩名男子被捕。
body: 警方星期三表示，破獲警隊歷來最大宗依托咪酯案，檢獲約25公斤懷疑依托咪酯粉末，估計市值超過3100萬港元。
毒品調查科星期二突擊搜查荔枝角一個工廈單位，搗破一個以物流公司辦公室作掩飾的毒品儲存倉，並檢獲大量包裝工具。行動中拘捕兩名男子。警方稱，其中一人是47歲非華裔、該物流公司的持牌股東，另一人是48歲本地職員。
警方估算，檢獲的粉末可製成超過12萬支依托咪酯煙彈。單位內亦有大量全新速遞包裝袋，調查發現有人試圖把毒品偽裝成一般貨物。
毒品調查科高級督察朱俊業表示，萬聖節將至，不排除有人已開始囤積相關毒品，並安排在節日期間供應給娛樂場所。兩名被捕男子正被扣留，預計星期四在西九龍裁判法院提堂，暫控販運危險藥物。
